card.title: PlayStation 5 Fault Finding Using UART

claims.statement: PS5 EMC (southbridge) UART is enabled by default (unlike PS4): solder RX, TX, GND (RX↔TX) and read logs with Console Service Tool > Sony > PlayStation 5, console plugged in but off.
Undocumented codes can be looked up on community databases such as uartcodes.com.

procedure: Connect USB-TTL; plug in AC, don't power on.
card.caveats: Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
